# SCI-FRUIT post-EL-F6 direction

Date: 2026-09-03

Status: **scientific-owner direction to prepare the next empirical-lane
decision; not exact authorization to execute EL-F7**

After reviewing the corrected EL-F6 interpretation and a summary of the
study, the scientific owner agreed with the proposed next steps:

> appreciated, and I agree with the next steps. Please proceed.

The agreed direction is to distinguish total adaptive response from a more
controlled source-response measurement, report real-field leakage separately,
and continue with a narrow experiment aimed at understanding the learned
detector-penalty mechanism before proposing a new FRUIT recurrence or a broad
policy change.

The manager's preparation check found that the most informative next step is
not yet a source-aware or softened-penalty candidate. The EL-F5 injected and
control checkpoints already differ in feedback maps, accumulated detector
weight evidence, one mask interval, learned target pixels, and the target UID
4460 penalty. A remedy tested directly against those already divergent states
could not cleanly show which part of the history it changed.

This direction therefore authorizes preparation and owner review of a bounded
shared-start response-decomposition experiment. It does not itself authorize
that experiment, a reduction, an algorithm or configuration-policy change, a
candidate safeguard, qualification, Gate D, Stage B authoring, production
use, or Unity activity. Exact execution requires approval of the content-bound
EL-F7 manifest.
